title: 默克与莫德纳股价大涨，黑色素瘤试验成功引关注
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Same, I say huge news because the market reaction has been huge.
segments.zh: 确实，这是重大消息，因为市场反应非常强烈。

segments.en: So in the pharmaceutical world, is this a really big breakthrough?
segments.zh: 那么在制药领域，这真的是一个重大突破吗？

segments.en: Oh, hi, Danny, I think the best share price to look at is Merck because that's where you're getting no dilution of the involvement of short covering that's probably going on
segments.zh: 嗨，Danny，我认为最值得关注的是默克公司的股价，因为那里没有空头回补的稀释效应，而现代公司开盘时的股价波动可能涉及空头回补。

segments.en: in the modern share price move at the open.
segments.zh: 这导致了现代公司开盘时的股价波动。

segments.en: So that's giving us a 6, 7% and 9% rise, right?
segments.zh: 所以这带来了6%、7%和9%的涨幅，对吧？

segments.en: This is huge for Merck, depending on the data, remember the press release only says that they succeeded at this interim level.
segments.zh: 这对默克来说意义重大，但取决于数据，记住新闻稿只说他们在中期阶段取得了成功。

segments.en: So it is a groundbreaking thing, it's a cancer vaccine, although they call it individualized in new therapy, new antigen therapy, it's a vaccine essentially.
segments.zh: 所以这是开创性的，它是一种癌症疫苗，尽管他们称之为个体化新疗法、新抗原疗法，但本质上是一种疫苗。

segments.en: And it's one of the first to be showing in this kind of big indication using mRNA that you might be able to do this.
segments.zh: 这是首批在这样的大适应症中展示使用mRNA可能实现这一点的疗法之一。

segments.en: I think therefore there's a lot coming in here also for hope for other indications, Danny.
segments.zh: 因此，我认为这也为其他适应症带来了希望，Danny。

segments.en: Is there a risk though, Sam, with political climate, especially where I am in the United States and sort of a growing anti-vax movement that is as successful as this is, maybe the
segments.zh: 但是，Sam，是否存在风险，尤其是在我所在的美国，反疫苗运动日益壮大，而这项疗法如此成功，也许……

segments.en: uptake rate will be limited because of that? Yeah, I don't think so, I don't think that cancer has the same issues as infectious diseases
segments.zh: 因此接种率会受限吗？我不这么认为，癌症与传染病或新冠、流感不同。

segments.en: or COVID or flu would have.
